# Devero Hotel Sold Out: AS Cambiago Available | MSC 2026

Devero Hotel has been sold out since August for Milano Sensual Congress 2026. Rooms are now available at the second hotel, AS Hotel Cambiago.

Canonical: https://milanosensualcongress.com/news/devero-hotel-sold-out-as-cambiago-2026

### Devero rooms sold out since August

**Devero Hotel, the main hotel for Milano Sensual Congress, has been sold out for the 2026 edition since August.** Thank you to everyone who has already booked their stay for our Bachata weekend on **20–22 November 2026**.

If you have yet to arrange accommodation, you can still stay close to the dancing: **AS Hotel Cambiago is now available as our second congress hotel.**

### Stay at AS Hotel Cambiago

AS Hotel Cambiago is a four-star hotel approximately **800 metres from Devero Hotel**, within walking distance of the event venue. It is the accommodation option for guests who still need a room for MSC 2026.

See the [MSC hotel page](https://milanosensualcongress.com/hotel) for room options, congress rates and booking information, or follow our [hotel booking guide](https://milanosensualcongress.com/BookHotel#as-hotel-cambiago).

### The congress stays at Devero

All congress workshops, shows and parties will take place at **Devero Hotel**. Guests staying at AS Hotel Cambiago will join the event there throughout the weekend.

Travelling to Milan from abroad? Check our [transfer information](https://milanosensualcongress.com/transfer) as you plan your journey. For help with your stay, visit the [MSC contact page](https://milanosensualcongress.com/contact).
